skills.name: Teardrops (泪珠/涙の雫)
skills.description: Ame Onna collects her magical tears in her umbrella and launches them at an a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Purifying Rain (净化之雨/浄化の雨)
skills.line: How long will it take before these tears stop pouring from my heart?
skills.description:
At the start of the turn, removes all controlling effects on self and dispels all debuffs. Gains 40 SPD for 1 turn when affected by debuffs or controlling effects (triggers at most once before own turn starts).
;Remove
:Removes the effects that cannot be dispelled.

skills.name: Sky Tear (天之泪/空の涙)
skills.line: Even the sky doesn't cry this much.
skills.description:
Select an allied target to remove all controlling effects they bear, and dispels all debuffs or controlling effects from all allies (up to four per allied shikigami).
Dispels 1 buff from each enemy and has a 100% base chance to inflict Shackle of Tears on them, lasting for 2 turns. ;Shackle of Tears (涙の絆) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Slows the inflicted target, decreasing their SPD by 10. ;Remove :Removes the effects that cannot be dispelled. ;Base Chance :Chance is affected by Effect HIT.

upgrades.text: Increases the selected allied target's Effect RES by 80% for 1 turn.
Number of enemy buffs that can be dispelled increases to 2.
'''Shackle of Tears''': Slow effect increases to 20.

bio.condition: Have Ame Onne gain 50000 Realm or Entrust EXP.
With Ame Onna clear any zone 50 times.
